The '''Enarc Run''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] that ran from [[Enarc/Legends|Enarc]] to [[Vondarc/Legends|Vondarc]]. Halfway along the run was a spur, the [[Kira Run]], which connected to [[Kira's sun|Kira]] and then the [[Harrin Trade Corridor]].

Planets along its path were [[Ropagi II]], [[Krann]], [[Plagen]], [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]], and [[Roldalna]].
